title: ATS v. Mirza B. (Pune Bakery IED Blast)
citation: Special MCOCA Sessions Court, Pune (Case 4/2010) / Bombay HC Review 2023
confidence_note: High (Forensic chemical recovery of RDX at residence, cyber cafe browsing logs)

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Mirza B. and conspirators (LeT / IM module)
ground_truth.rationale: Chemical trace match of RDX explosive residue at residence; cyber cafe IP logs booking transit tickets; fake electoral card.

hypotheses.label: Mirza B. & Terror Module
hypotheses.statement: Mirza B. procured RDX explosives, assembled the detonator in Udgir, and provided logistical shelter for the planters.

hypotheses.label: Rogue Kitchen Cylinder Explosion
hypotheses.statement: An industrial commercial LPG kitchen cylinder suffered catastrophic rupture at the bakery counter.

hypotheses.label: Foreign Tourist Syndicate
hypotheses.statement: International narcotics traffickers detonated ordnance to eliminate an informant.

exhibits.name: CFSL Pune Post-Blast Chemical Residue Analysis
exhibits.text: Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) of swab samples from blast crater confirmed traces of RDX, Ammonium Nitrate, and Hydrocarbon petroleum oil. Completely disproves LPG cylinder rupture.

exhibits.name: Udgir Residence Search - Explosive Seizure Memo
exhibits.text: Seizure of 1,200 grams of blackish explosive powder from accused Mirza B.'s Udgir premises. Chemical composition matched military grade RDX identical to blast scene residue.

exhibits.name: Central Cyber Cafe IP Server Access Log
exhibits.text: Cyber cafe terminal log in Udgir shows browsing of Pune Koregaon Park topography under alias Syed Kharadi. MAC address tied to physical desktop workstation.

exhibits.name: Witness Deposition of Auto-Rickshaw Driver
exhibits.text: Auto driver recalled ferrying two young men with heavy rucksacks near Pune railway station but could not identify faces during test identification parade.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Planted Kitchen Gas Safety Certificate
adversarial_exhibit.text: Forged inspection report claiming a commercial gas valve was recalled for sudden catastrophic rupture.
